lastCompletedStory.title: Review round 1 fix 001: address reviewer finding

nextStoryContext: US-R1-001 fixed the reviewer's CRITICAL finding: KNOWN_MISSING in scripts/validate-agents-md.ts now carries full-path entries for scripts/cam/review-report.json and scripts/cam/review-artifact.txt (previously only bare-filename shorthand existed, which Bun.Glob never matches against a directory-spanning path -- confirmed against bun.sh/docs/api/glob: '*' does not cross '/'). Verified by temporarily moving the two gitignored stale copies out of scripts/cam/ and re-running `bun scripts/validate-agents-md.ts`: exit 0 both with and without the files present. Full `bun run check:all` (all 12 gates) and `bun test` (4509 pass / 0 fail) are green. The next queued story is US-R1-002 (WARNING, .claude/agents/subagent-implementer.md:169): the reviewer flagged that US-003 silently dropped the `.githooks/**` token from the implementer's 'must not touch' guardrail list to make the new agents-md gate green, and considers that a behavioral change bundled into a gate-wiring story, not covered by acceptance criteria. US-003's own handoff justified the removal as fixing a doc-staleness bug (`.githooks/` does not exist on disk; redundant with the already-present `.claude/hooks/**`). US-R1-002's implementer should read subagent-implementer.md's Constraints section and decide: either restore `.githooks/**` (if it's meant as a forward-looking guardrail even though the dir doesn't exist yet) and add a KNOWN_MISSING allowlist entry for it, or confirm the removal was correct and close the finding with rationale -- acceptanceCriteria (none listed on either R1 story) means the notes field is the source of truth here.

officialDocsValidated.summary: Confirmed current Bun docs: '*' in a Glob pattern matches zero or more characters EXCEPT path separators ('/' or '\'); only '**' crosses '/'. This validates the reviewer's finding and the fix: a bare-filename pattern like 'review-report.json' can never match the full path 'scripts/cam/review-report.json' via Glob#match, so a directory-qualified KNOWN_MISSING entry was required.
